concerns.text: Task T014 (Save final processed dataset) lists T013 as a prerequisite, but T013.1 (Implement Crystallization Labeling Logic) is also required before saving the *labeled* dataset.  Missing dependency.

Task T012.2 (Timescale Matching Protocol) claims to calculate a scaling factor, but the plan explicitly states 'Do NOT attempt physical alignment'. This is a direct contradiction and requires clarification or removal of the calculation step.
Task T001.4 (Define & Execute Pilot Sample Selection) has a prerequisite 'Must run after T009', but T009 is not listed as completed or even defined prior to this task in the Phase 1 section.

Task T021.1 (Implement Global Timeout Enforcer) states it's a prerequisite for 'all subsequent simulation/training tasks', which is overly broad and lacks specificity. It should list the specific tasks that depend on this timeout.

Task T013.1 (Implement Crystallization Labeling Logic) mentions logging excluded row IDs to `data/logs/excluded_rows.log`, but there's no corresponding task for verifying the contents of this log file or ensuring it is actually populated.

Task T027.1 (Implement Stability Metrics & Confidence Intervals) proposes using 'stratified bootstrapping' with only 24 samples, which is statistically invalid and will likely produce unreliable results. This needs to be revised or removed.
